title: U.S. Geological Survey Northern Rocky Mountain Science Center science highlights for fiscal year 2023
abstract: The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Northern Rocky Mountain Science Center is based in Bozeman, Montana, and has field offices in Glacier National Park, Mont.; Missoula, Mont.; and Knoxville, Tennessee.
